Property on the ground floor at street level with the technical and urban process resolved: Basic and execution project endorsed by the Official Association of Architects of Malaga (COAM) to transform the surface into 2 modern independent high-profit studies/lofts.
Save months of administrative and technical management and start the work of adaptation immediately.
Technical sheet of the property and projects Total built area: 106.07 m2 (92.47 m2 current useful).
Location: C/ Sondalezas Nº 1 (locals 4 and 5), consolidated area with all services, shops and direct transport to the center of Malaga.

Projected installations: Complete pre-installation of individual air conditioning, high power electricity (9.2 kW), reinforced acoustic insulation and optimal energy rating.
Why is it a strategic investment? Double Rental Return: The subdivision into 2 independent residential units maximizes the monthly yield in the traditional or half-stay rental market.
Total legal and technical security: Technical documentation and strict compliance with the CTE and Municipal Ordinances of Malaga.
Ready to execute: Diaphanous space that optimizes the costs and deadlines of internal civil works.
